goal_text: (Reused from research_synth_009) What were the three main structural causes of World War I? Name the alliance blocs involved and explain the role of the Balkan crisis.
ground_truth: The three structural causes are: (1) the alliance system — the Triple Alliance (Germany, Austria-Hungary, Italy) and the Triple Entente (France, Russia, Britain) locked nations into automatic war obligations; (2) militarism — the Anglo-German naval arms race and Schlieffen Plan reflected offensive military planning; (3) nationalism — pan-Slavic movements in the Balkans, especially Serbian nationalism, created pressure on Austria-Hungary and Russia.
